modules.orbitHint: Explore each feature and see how it transforms the way you run your club.

orbitFeatures.label: Dashboard
orbitFeatures.description: See the state of your club at a glance.
orbitFeatures.before: Compiling numbers by hand before every committee meeting.
orbitFeatures.after: Open the dashboard — key indicators are already there.
orbitFeatures.result: Faster decisions based on up-to-date data.

orbitFeatures.label: Members
orbitFeatures.description: Centralise every member profile in one place.
orbitFeatures.before: Hunting for info across Excel, emails and paper folders.
orbitFeatures.after: A complete profile, always up to date and available to the committee.
orbitFeatures.result: No more scattered lists — everyone sees the same reality.

orbitFeatures.label: Membership fees
orbitFeatures.description: Send a membership fee to all members in a few clicks.
orbitFeatures.before: Preparing every fee and chasing members by hand.
orbitFeatures.after: Select members, enter the details, then send everything in a few clicks.
orbitFeatures.result: Dozens of minutes saved on every fee campaign.

orbitFeatures.label: Invoices
orbitFeatures.description: Create and track invoices without friction.
orbitFeatures.before: Writing invoices manually and losing track of payments.
orbitFeatures.after: Generate, send and follow the status of every invoice.
orbitFeatures.result: Clean tracking — no more spreadsheets or lost files.

orbitFeatures.label: Collections
orbitFeatures.description: Clearly follow what has been collected.
orbitFeatures.before: Reconciling fees, canteen and events across multiple files.
orbitFeatures.after: One readable view of collections, ready to filter.
orbitFeatures.result: Club cash flow becomes clear in seconds.

orbitFeatures.label: Revenue
orbitFeatures.description: Track product and side revenue for the club.
orbitFeatures.before: Logging kits, raffles and meals on separate sheets.
orbitFeatures.after: Record every product revenue in one place.
orbitFeatures.result: A clear view of what the club actually generates.

orbitFeatures.label: Expenses
orbitFeatures.before: Piling up receipts with no overview.
orbitFeatures.after: Log and categorise expenses alongside income.

orbitFeatures.label: Sponsoring
orbitFeatures.after: Every partner, amount and status visible at a glance.
orbitFeatures.result: Fewer missed renewals, more partnerships kept on time.

orbitFeatures.label: Events
orbitFeatures.description: Organise events without an Excel sheet.
orbitFeatures.before: Managing sign-ups across files and scattered messages.
orbitFeatures.after: Create the event, open sign-ups and track in real time.
orbitFeatures.result: Organising a match or tournament becomes readable.

orbitFeatures.label: Canteen
orbitFeatures.description: Manage canteen slots and requests simply.
orbitFeatures.before: Coordinating the canteen via messages and improvised tables.
orbitFeatures.after: Bookings and slots centralised for the committee.
orbitFeatures.result: Less match-day stress, more clarity for the team.

orbitFeatures.label: Schedules
orbitFeatures.description: Create roles, share a link, let volunteers sign up.
orbitFeatures.before: Chasing everyone to see who’s available.
orbitFeatures.result: The schedule fills without endless WhatsApp threads.

orbitFeatures.label: Minutes
orbitFeatures.description: Write and share meeting minutes quickly.
orbitFeatures.before: Writing, formatting and redistributing minutes by hand.
orbitFeatures.after: Structure the meeting and export a share-ready PDF.
orbitFeatures.result: Clean minutes, ready in a fraction of the time.

orbitFeatures.label: QR Codes
orbitFeatures.description: Create links and QR codes for quick sign-ups.
orbitFeatures.before: Collecting sign-ups via forms and scattered messages.
orbitFeatures.after: Generate a QR code and share it in one click.
orbitFeatures.result: Sign-ups arrive on their own — no paperwork.

orbitFeatures.label: Communication
orbitFeatures.description: Send targeted campaigns to your members.
orbitFeatures.before: Copy-pasting email lists and chasing people manually.
orbitFeatures.after: Create a campaign and send it to the right audience.
orbitFeatures.result: Less wasted time, more consistent communication.

orbitFeatures.label: Public page
orbitFeatures.before: Maintaining a site or posts for every update.
orbitFeatures.after: A clear public page: programme, canteen, sign-ups.
orbitFeatures.result: A professional club showcase without complex web work.

orbitFeatures.label: Settings
orbitFeatures.description: Configure the club and committee access.
orbitFeatures.before: Everyone has the same access… or no one has the right ones.
orbitFeatures.after: Assign the right permissions for each committee role.
orbitFeatures.result: Smooth collaboration without sharing every permission.

whyChoose.label: 03 / WHY CHOOSE OBILLZ
whyChoose.title: Why choose Obillz?
whyChoose.description: Obillz does more than bring every club feature together in one platform.
whyChoose.secondaryDescription: We built a tool around how sports clubs actually work — to simplify volunteers' daily life and give them back precious time.

cards.title: Built by people from the field.
paragraphs: Obillz wasn't imagined in an office.
We grew up in sports clubs and know, from the inside, the daily challenges volunteers face.
Every feature answers a real need observed on the ground.

cards.title: Fewer manual tasks.
paragraphs: Actions that used to take hours become simple processes you can finish in minutes.
Your committee spends less time on admin and more time on the club.

cards.title: Everything in one place.
paragraphs: Members, dues, finances, documents, events, sponsors, schedules and much more.

cards.title: Simple from day one.
paragraphs: A clear, intuitive interface that's quick to pick up.
Your committee can get started right away.

cards.title: A platform that grows with clubs.
paragraphs: We regularly talk with the clubs using Obillz.
When a need comes up often, we do our best to ship a new feature.
Your feedback directly shapes the platform.

pricing.headline: Give your committee a tool worthy of their commitment.
pricing.body: Running a club already takes enough time. Obillz brings members, fees, finances, events, sponsors and committee collaboration together in one easy-to-use platform.

everythingIncluded.title: Everything your club needs, in one plan.
everythingIncluded.subtitle: Obillz brings together the essential features to simplify your club management — without unnecessary complexity.

items.question: Are there hidden fees?
items.answer: No. One plan, one clear price. All essential features are included — no locked modules or surprises.

items.question: Can I try Obillz before committing?
items.answer: Yes. You get a 7-day free trial with no credit card and no commitment.

items.question: Does the plan include all features?
items.answer: Yes. The Club Plan gives you access to all essential modules to run your club day to day.

items.question: Is Obillz suitable for all clubs?
items.answer: Yes. Whether you run a small local club or a more structured organization, Obillz adapts to your needs.

reassuranceBlocks: Free trial|Try Obillz for 7 days — no credit card required.
Everything included|Your club gets all essential modules without choosing between multiple plans.
Personal support|Contact the founder to ask questions or request a demo.

finalCta.title: Ready to simplify your club management?
finalCta.subtitle: Try Obillz for free and discover a clearer way to run your club.

faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about Obillz, how it works, and your subscription.
faq.reassurance: Clear answers, no jargon — so you can move forward with confidence.

items.question: Is Obillz suitable for all sports clubs?
items.answer: Yes. Football, hockey, tennis, volleyball or local associations: members, fees, invoices, events and schedules in one place.

items.question: How long to set up the club?
items.answer: A few minutes to create your space. Add members and launch your first fees whenever you're ready.

items.question: Do members need to install an app?
items.answer: No. Pay, sign up for events or get info via links and QR codes — no app required.

items.question: What happens after the {days}-day trial?
items.answer: After {days} days, the account becomes read-only. Your data stays visible; editing returns with a subscription.

items.question: What does the Obillz subscription include?
items.answer: The Obillz subscription gives you access to all the platform's main features: member management, fees, events, sponsors, documents, finances and committee access. The goal is a simple, clear and complete offer — without multiple plans.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Yes, anytime. Access stays active until the end of the paid period.

items.question: Why choose yearly billing?
items.answer: 2 months free compared to monthly — ideal for long-term use.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Secure hosting, protected access and payments via Stripe.

ourStory.label: OUR STORY
ourStory.title: The story behind Obillz.
ourStory.subtitle: A journey born on the ground — clubs, committees and volunteers.
ourStory.manifesto: Obillz wasn’t imagined in an office. It was born on the ground.

grandir.title: Growing up in clubs
grandir.body: We grew up in sports clubs — training sessions, tournaments, snack bars, events and late committee nights.

observer.title: Seeing the problems
observer.body: Over the years, the same issues kept coming back everywhere: Excel, WhatsApp, scattered documents, fees, messy organisation.

idee.title: An idea
idee.body: We wondered why no tool was truly designed for volunteers.

creer.title: Creating Obillz
creer.body: We started building something simple. Not software imagined in an office, but a tool shaped by real needs on the ground.

construire.title: Building with clubs
construire.body: Obillz still evolves thanks to club feedback. When a need comes up again and again, we do our best to ship a new feature.
